logfile.description: Filename to log to. If empty or not set, defaults to STDOUT.

method.description: The wiping method (e.g., dod, gutmann, zero, quick, dod522022m, ops2, random, prng, stream, is5enh).

rounds.description: Number of times to wipe the device using the selected method.

verify.description: Whether to perform verification of erasure: off, last, or all.

sync.description: Perform a sync after this many writes. 0 for full disk write, 1 for every write.

prng.description: PRNG option: mersenne, twister, isaac, or isaac64.

pdfreportpath.description: Directory to write the PDF nwipe reports/certificates to. Use 'noPDF' to disable.

noblank.description: Do not perform the final blanking pass after the wipe.

nowait.description: Do not wait for a key before exiting.

nosignals.description: Do not allow signals to interrupt a wipe.

nousb.description: Do not show or wipe any USB devices.

nogui.description: Do not show the GUI interface. Can only be used with autonuke.

quiet.description: Anonymize serial numbers in logs and GUI.

verbose.description: Log more messages, useful for debugging.

exclude_devices.description: Up to ten comma separated devices to be excluded, e.g., ['/dev/sdc', '/dev/sdd'].

autonuke.description: Start wiping all devices (or specified ones) immediately without user confirmation.

autopoweroff.description: Power off system on completion of wipe delayed for one minute.
